messages:
cleo: tiny emergency  the office stapler has gone AWOL. last seen near the whiteboard during the retro. who liberated it? :eyes:

omar: that might be the Stapler of Solitude. rumor says it walks to people who need to attach agendas. not me tho, promise. :raised_hand:

jin: i borrowed a stapler yesterday but returned it to the supply drawer? checked now, not there. :mag:

cleo: there is a sticky note on the supply drawer that says "DO NOT STAPLE THE PLANT" so clearly someone was very close to it. :potted_plant:

marta: i confess i hid a stapler in my desk during demo week to prevent accidental mass stapling of printouts. possible suspect. :grimacing:

omar: we should consider a chaining protocol. like a tiny chain and a name tag. or a GPS sticker (joke).

ops-bot: Friendly reminder: communal items should be returned to the supply cabinet after use. Lost items can be logged here: https://redwood/internal/lostfound (auto) :bell:

jin: poll: 1) buy an identical backup stapler and label both 2) implement stapler-checkout sign-out 3) declare staple-free Fridays. cast votes.

cleo: 1

marta: 2 (i'll make the sign-out sheet)

omar: 3 (i love the chaos of staple-free Fridays)

hr-bot: Small reminder: please don't remove shared office equipment from communal areas without prior coordination to avoid impacting teammates. Thanks! :handshake: (auto)

cleo: vote tally: 1 backup, 2 sign-out, 3 staple-free. leaning toward 1+2 combo: backup stapler labeled "Spare: Do Not Hoard" plus sign-out for the Nice Stapler.

marta: i'll drop a labeled backup in the cabinet today and create the sign-out doc. also, can we get a tiny sticker that says "Stapler of Solitude" for the original if it reappears? aesthetic matters. :sparkles:

omar: if it returns, we should hold a tiny re-dedication ceremony. cake optional.

cleo: agreed. archived this thread as "Stapler Summit" in the lore folder. future HR will appreciate the paper trail. :scroll:

jin: found a stapler. it's on top of the microwave. mystery deepens. :detective:
